n-credits-for-holders.title: AI credits for holders
n-credits-for-holders.summary: Coins that describe turning trading fees into AI model credits for holders. Orbio (orbio.so) says it sells LLM credits at a discount, that the discount comes from Orbio holders who offer unused credit, and that requests are relayed through its managed OpenRouter account; its coin ORBIO (pons, Robinhood Chain) says half of trading fees are converted into inference credits paid to holders. API (pump.fun) says fees are split by holdings and holders can claim SOL or 1.5x credits for GPT, Claude, Grok and Gemini through one OpenAI-compatible API; LLMPad (LLM, pump.fun) says it lets anyone launch model tokens or trading agents and generate LLM credits; bInference (BINF, Flap, BNB Chain) says an agent token's fees pay for the agent's AI and that credits bought with BNB are up to 8% cheaper with $BINF. Public posts from 2026-10-09 and 2026-10-10 compare BINF and API with ORBIO, and a rival project, DecentraMind, says ORBIO pioneered the model it builds on. The ORBIO and BINF pools date from 2026-09-20 and 2026-09-30; the API and LLM pools were created on 2026-10-09 and 2026-10-10. These are the projects' and traders' own claims: payouts, discounts and usage are not verified, no affiliation among the coins was checked, and one post says 11 bundles bought 62% of LLM's supply around its launch. Measured: four coins across all their pools.

summaries.n-post-quantum: Coins that market themselves on post-quantum cryptography and the "bunker mode" debate. On 2026-10-07 Ethereum Foundation researcher Justin Drake posted a call for the industry to "calmly begin planning for 'bunker mode'", recommending a controlled mass migration of assets to fresh addresses whose public keys stay hidden behind a hash; coverage ties the call to AI-accelerated math breaking wallet cryptography. The same day Vitalik Buterin posted that he does not recommend scrambling to move funds today but that risks to cryptography from AI-accelerated math, next to quantum, should be taken seriously, and The Block reported Europol urging the industry to prepare for quantum threats. pqc.market describes launching pump.fun coins with hash-based post-quantum attestations (WOTS one-time keys, Merkle identities); its own coin PQC and the coins QI (Quantum Inu), Tardigrade, Quantcum and BNKR (Bunker Coin) say in their metadata that they launched with its post-quantum proofs, BUNKER (Bunker Mode) describes vaults with separate hash-based authorization, and Qhost (QHOST, on Robinhood Chain) calls itself a quantum-resistant launchpad whose coins sit behind keys a quantum computer cannot break. All seven pools were created after the 2026-10-07 posts. None is shown to be affiliated with Drake, the Ethereum Foundation or Europol, and the coins' security claims are not verified. Measured: seven coins across all their pools.
summaries.n-super-intelligence: On Sept. 29 Trump said AI would officially be renamed "Super Intelligence" (Fox News). On 2026-10-04 the official @WhiteHouse account posted an announcement of a "Super Intelligence Force (SIF)", and Watcher.Guru and an @wallstreetbets post reported Elon Musk saying SpaceXAI will be renamed SpaceXSI. Super Inu ($SI), launched Sept. 21, re-pitched itself around the term; other coins followed, including another SI on pump.fun, 四 ("four", read as SI) on four.meme, Super Intelligence Force (SIF), Superintelligence Owl, two SpaceXSI coins on StonkFun, SpaceX Inu ($SI on Flap), Act II: The SI Prophecy, SuperHooks, two newer pump.fun coins, SpaceX Super Intelligence (SPACEXSI) and My Super Intelligent Cat (Ollie), whose metadata names the term, and two BNB Chain coins on Flap named TeslaSI ("Tesla Super Intelligence", pool created 2026-10-11, and a second whose Chinese metadata says it follows the SpaceXAI to SpaceXSI rename). None is shown to be affiliated with the announcements. Smaller coins named for SpaceXSI under the $100K market cap bar are not counted. Measured: sixteen coins across all their pools.
summaries.n-tokenized-assets: Coins whose metadata describes tokenized stocks or real-world assets (RWAs). @RobinhoodCrypto posted on 2026-10-08 that it is exploring a Stock Token linked to an actively managed ETF with T. Rowe Price DA ("if successful"), and on 2026-09-08 that Robinhood Stock Tokens had reached $150M in TVL on Robinhood Chain. Apps built around those tokens have coins of their own: Borro.Markets (BORRO; "Lend, borrow and short stock tokens"), HyperDex (HYDX; "Unified Marketplace for Tokenized Assets & RWAs"), Prism Assets (PRISM; "tokenising real-world assets with AI"), Longbow (BOW; borrow USDG against tokenized stocks and RWAs), Quanta Pools (QUANTA; liquidity across Stock Tokens and RWAs), Mintfolio (MINTFOLIO; baskets of stocks and ETFs), opcode (OP; "The RWA prop AMM for every chain"), TARTAGLIA (TATA; "ZK dark pool for tokenized stocks"), and two pons coins created on 2026-10-11, HUME MARKETS (HUME; "Tokenized stocks, all in one place. Perps. Options. Lending & Borrowing.") and Ballast (BLLS; "Stock Token portfolios on @Robinhoodapp that rebalance themselves"). On Solana, Tokenize Everything (EVERYTHING; pool created 2026-10-07) describes tokenized RWAs as the biggest crypto meta of the last year and a half; one 2026-10-07 post by @RaOnChain called it a scam. None of the coins is shown to be issued by or affiliated with Robinhood, and their product descriptions are their own claims. Measured: eleven coins across all their pools.

n-post-quantum.notice: Justin Drake (Ethereum Foundation researcher) posted on 2026-10-07 a call to calmly begin planning for "bunker mode" (migrating assets to addresses whose public keys stay hidden behind a hash); Vitalik Buterin posted the same day that he does not recommend scrambling to move funds today but that AI-accelerated math and quantum risks to cryptography deserve to be taken seriously; The Block reported Europol urging preparation for quantum threats. Business Insider quoted the call on 2026-10-08 and posts summarizing the debate were still appearing on 2026-10-12.
n-post-quantum.interpretation: The cryptography-risk debate is real and still being discussed, and these coins market themselves on it. The coins are not shown to be affiliated with the people or agencies quoted, their post-quantum claims are their own and unverified, and the debate itself is about possible risks, not a demonstrated break. The coins' volume has fallen sharply since the first days.

n-super-intelligence.notice: The White House SIF and SpaceXSI posts date from 2026-10-04 (e1:6); a 2026-10-09 post reports Trump calling anyone who uses the term "Artificial Intelligence" the enemy. No newer official announcement was found in today's searches; $SI posts on 2026-10-11 discuss the original developer leaving and the community continuing (e1:1).
n-super-intelligence.interpretation: The rename story is real but several days old, and volume across the coins has fallen sharply from the first days. Two new BNB Chain coins named TeslaSI ride the SpaceXSI rename; the sources found describe a SpaceXAI to SpaceXSI rename only, and none of the coins is shown to be affiliated with the announcements.
